# Phase Fraction Time Series

Category: materials

Build a simple phase-fraction curve and summarize the final transformed fraction.

import numpy as np

time_s = np.linspace(0.0, 120.0, 9)
fraction = 1.0 - np.exp(-time_s / 45.0)
print('time_s =', time_s)
print('fraction =', np.round(fraction, 4))
fraction[-1]
